from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'daphne/server.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('daphne.server')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
import asyncio
import time
from unittest import mock
import daphne.server as srvmod
from daphne.server import Server
loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
done = loop.create_future()
done.set_result(None)
stuck = loop.create_future()
srv = Server.__new__(Server)
srv.application_close_timeout = 10
srv.connections = {'p_new': {}}
srv.protocol_disconnected('p_new')
print('marked', srv.connections['p_new'].get('disconnected'))
assert srv.connections['p_new'].get('disconnected'), 'disconnect must stamp release time once'
del srv.connections['p_new']
srv.connections.update({
    'p_done': {'application_instance': done, 'disconnected': time.time()},
    'p_stuck': {'application_instance': stuck, 'disconnected': time.time() - 100},
})
with mock.patch.object(srvmod.reactor, 'callLater') as cl:
    srv.application_checker()
    assert cl.called
assert stuck.cancelled(), 'stuck app past close timeout must be cancelled'
assert srv.connections == {}, 'reaped and cancelled connections must be fully released'
print('disconnect_mark_ok')
